docs.text: dot-cache Dotkernel cache component based on symfony-cache. dot-cache is a wrapper on top of symfony/cache dot-cache uses symfony/cache since version 4.0 . Version 3.x of dot-cache is the last version that uses laminas/laminas-cache . Documentation Documentation is available at: https://docs.dotkernel.org/dot-cache/. Versions Version Supported PHP Cache backend 5.x :white_check_mark: 8.3 to 8.6 symfony/cache 7.4 or 8.1+ 4.x Security fixes only 8.2 to 8.5 symfony/cache 7.x <= 3.x :x: laminas/laminas-cache Upgrading from 4.x ? Read the upgrade guide . Badges This package supports only array and filesystem adapters, you can use multiple adapters at once. Installation Run the following command in your project directory composer require dotkernel/dot-cache After installing, add the Dot\Cache\ConfigProvider::class class to your configuration aggregate. Configuration for Doctrine in-memory cache In config\autoload\doctrine.global.php you need to add the following configurations: Under the doctrine.configuration.orm_default key add the following config: 'result_cache' => 'array', 'metadata_cache' => 'array', 'query_cache' => 'array', 'hydration_cache' => 'array', 'second_level_cache' => [ 'enabled' => true, 'default_lifetime' => 3600, 'default_lock_lifetime' => 60, 'file_lock_region_directory' => '', 'regions' => [], ], Next, under the doctrine key add the following config: 'cache' => [ 'array' => [ 'class' => \Dot\Cache\Adapter\ArrayAdapter::class, ], ], The above configuration will use an in-memory cache, because you use the array adapter. If you want to store the cache into files on your local disk, you will need to use the filesystem adapter. Configuration for Doctrine cache using filesystem The filesystem adapter needs some extra configurations: directory (required): folder path namespace : directory name default_lifetime : item lifetime in seconds, 0 for no expiry marshaller : service name or instance of a Symfony marshaller 'cache' => [ 'array' => [ 'class' => \Dot\Cache\Adapter\ArrayAdapter::class, ], 'filesystem' => [ 'class' => \Dot\Cache\Adapter\FilesystemAdapter::class, 'directory' => getcwd() . '/data/cache', 'namespace' => 'doctrine', ], ], You can store result_cache , metadata_cache , query_cache , hydration_cache into files using the filesystem adapter, or you can store the result_cache into memory using the array adapter. Configuration example for both in-memory and filesystem adapters Configuration sample for config\autoload\doctrine.global.php file. The dependencies are registered by Dot\Cache\ConfigProvider , so they are not repeated here. return [ 'doctrine' => [ 'configuration' => [ 'orm_default' => [ 'result_cache' => 'array', 'metadata_cache' => 'array', 'query_cache' => 'filesystem', 'hydration_cache' => 'array', 'second_level_cache' => [ 'enabled' => true, 'default_lifetime' => 3600, 'default_lock_lifetime' => 60, 'file_lock_region_directory' => '', 'regions' => [], ], ], ], 'cache' => [ 'array' => [ 'class' => \Dot\Cache\Adapter\ArrayAdapter::class, ], 'filesystem' => [ 'class' => \Dot\Cache\Adapter\FilesystemAdapter::class, 'directory' => getcwd() . '/data/cache', 'namespace' => 'doctrine', ], ], ], ]; The above configuration is just a sample, it should not be used as it is. You can enable/disable the caching system using the doctrine.configuration.orm_default.second_level_cache.enabled key.

docs.text: Configuration After installation, register dot-cache package in your project by adding the below line to your configuration aggregator (usually: config/config.php ): Dot\Cache\ConfigProvider::class, In config\autoload\doctrine.global.php you need to add the following configurations: Under the doctrine.configuration.orm_default key add the following config: 'result_cache' => 'array', 'metadata_cache' => 'array', 'query_cache' => 'array', 'hydration_cache' => 'array', 'second_level_cache' => [ 'enabled' => true, 'default_lifetime' => 3600, 'default_lock_lifetime' => 60, 'file_lock_region_directory' => '', 'regions' => [], ], Next, under the doctrine key add the following config: 'cache' => [ 'array' => [ 'class' => \Dot\Cache\Adapter\ArrayAdapter::class, ], ], The above configuration is just a sample and will use the in-memory adapter, it should be adapted to the app's needs. To disable the cache make sure the enabled key is false . Using both adapters at the same time You can use both adapters at the same time, your configuration can look like this: 'result_cache' => 'filesystem', 'metadata_cache' => 'array', 'query_cache' => 'filesystem', 'hydration_cache' => 'array', 'second_level_cache' => [ 'enabled' => true, 'default_lifetime' => 3600, 'default_lock_lifetime' => 60, 'file_lock_region_directory' => '', 'regions' => [], ],

docs.text: Upgrading to 5.x dot-cache 5.x still uses symfony/cache , like 4.x. Most applications only need to bump the version constraint and check their doctrine.cache.filesystem config. composer require dotkernel/dot-cache:^5.0 Changes that can break your code Change Symptom Fix PHP 8.2 support dropped Composer refuses to install Upgrade to PHP 8.3 or newer symfony/cache 7.0 to 7.3 no longer allowed Composer conflict with another package pinned to an old Symfony 7 minor Update to Symfony 7.4, or 8.1+ on PHP 8.4+ Symfony 8 is installed on PHP 8.4+ Error: Unknown named parameter $storeSerialized when creating ArrayAdapter Symfony 8 renamed the argument to deepClone . Use deepClone: or a positional argument directory is now required for the filesystem adapter Dot\Cache\Exception\InvalidConfigException while the container builds the adapter Set doctrine.cache.filesystem.directory . In 4.x a missing directory silently stored the cache in the system temp directory Config values are validated InvalidConfigException instead of a PHP TypeError Fix the key named in the message ConfigProvider and FilesystemAdapterFactory are final Class ... cannot extend final class Wrap or decorate them instead of extending. The adapters are still not final Changes in behaviour Change Effect What to do default_lifetime is now read In 4.x only default_life_time worked, and default_lifetime was silently ignored Use default_lifetime . If both are set, default_lifetime wins default_life_time is deprecated Still works in 5.x Rename it to default_lifetime before 6.0 Numeric strings are accepted for default_lifetime '3600' (for example from an environment variable) now works Nothing marshaller can be a service name It is fetched from the container Nothing Example Before (4.x): 'filesystem' => [ 'class' => \Dot\Cache\Adapter\FilesystemAdapter::class, 'namespace' => 'doctrine', 'default_life_time' => 3600, ], After (5.x): 'filesystem' => [ 'class' => \Dot\Cache\Adapter\FilesystemAdapter::class, 'directory' => getcwd() . '/data/cache', 'namespace' => 'doctrine', 'default_lifetime' => 3600, ],
docs.title: Upgrading to 5.x

docs.text: Configuring the filesystem adapter The filesystem adapter stores the cache on the hard disk. In config\autoload\doctrine.global.php you need to add the following configurations, under the doctrine key: 'cache' => [ 'filesystem' => [ 'class' => \Dot\Cache\Adapter\FilesystemAdapter::class, 'directory' => getcwd() . '/data/cache', 'namespace' => 'doctrine', ], ], The factory reads its settings from the doctrine.cache.filesystem entry, so keep that name. Key Required Default Description directory Yes none Path where cache files are stored namespace No '' Sub-directory inside directory default_lifetime No 0 Lifetime of cache items in seconds; 0 means no expiry. Integer or numeric string marshaller No Symfony's DefaultMarshaller Service name or instance of Symfony\Component\Cache\Marshaller\MarshallerInterface The key default_life_time is still read for backwards compatibility, but it is deprecated. Use default_lifetime . If directory is missing or empty, or any key has the wrong type, the factory throws Dot\Cache\Exception\InvalidConfigException naming the key. Under the doctrine.configuration.orm_default key add the following config: 'result_cache' => 'filesystem', 'metadata_cache' => 'filesystem', 'query_cache' => 'filesystem', 'hydration_cache' => 'filesystem', 'second_level_cache' => [ 'enabled' => true, 'default_lifetime' => 3600, 'default_lock_lifetime' => 60, 'file_lock_region_directory' => '', 'regions' => [], ],
